claim: The actual degree-four level-three j coordinate pair gives covering target-coordinate opens on both rational affine source charts, has exact overlap scaling and evaluates to the original modular j function, while explicitly failing at a characteristic-three base point.

obligations.name: Exact homogeneous pair and degree
obligations.required_input: The original j formula on T must determine the pair, rather than a merely isomorphic rational function.
obligations.constructed_input: homogeneousNumerator(x,y)=(x+27y)(x+243y)^3 and homogeneousDenominator(x,y)=x^3y; numerator_scale and denominator_scale prove common degree four.
obligations.justification: Both scale by exactly a^4. No degree-preserving Proj.map application is made, since the pinned API cannot directly accept this degree-four substitution.

obligations.name: Full finite source chart over Q
obligations.required_input: The numerator and denominator must generate the unit ideal on all of Spec Q[T], not only on complex closed points.
obligations.justification: finite_coprime divides this exact identity by the nonzero rational 3^27. Thus coefficient inversion is explicit; no Z-coprimality is inferred.

obligations.name: Full reciprocal source chart
obligations.required_input: Coverage must include the reciprocal origin corresponding to source infinity.
obligations.justification: The reciprocal coefficient B is 756+196830S+19131876S^2+387420489S^3. The identity is checked by ring normalization and directly gives reciprocal_coprime.

obligations.name: Prime-spectrum open coverage
obligations.required_input: Every prime in both affine source charts must lie in a target-coordinate domain.
obligations.constructed_input: finite_basicOpen_cover and reciprocal_basicOpen_cover prove D(F) sup D(G)=top in their actual prime spectra.
obligations.justification: The generic helper applies the exact Bezout equality inside an arbitrary prime ideal. Simultaneous membership of F and G would put 1 in that proper ideal. It does not restrict to maximal ideals, geometric points or a dense open.

obligations.name: Overlap and scalar compatibility
obligations.required_input: Finite and reciprocal source expressions must represent the same homogeneous pair with an explicit invertible scalar on the overlap.
obligations.constructed_input: chart_pair_overlap proves N(T,1)=T^4 N(1,S) and D(T,1)=T^4 D(1,S) under TS=1 over every commutative ring.
obligations.justification: The two identities specialize the degree-four scaling lemmas. The common T^4 is retained. This provides the ring-level comparison input for later scheme-chart gluing, not the gluing itself.

obligations.name: Geometric nonvanishing and characteristic restriction
obligations.required_input: No common projective zero in characteristic zero, without silently extending that claim to all integral fibers.
obligations.constructed_input: no_common_zero handles every nonzero homogeneous pair over a characteristic-zero field; characteristic_three_base_point exhibits the nonzero pair [0:1] where both coordinates vanish in ZMod 3.
obligations.justification: The proof splits x^3*y=0 and uses 27 and 243 nonzero only with CharZero. The explicit characteristic-three counterexample prevents treating the same pair as an everywhere-defined Z-model.

obligations.name: Identity with actual polynomial evaluations
obligations.required_input: The polynomials reserved for the scheme charts must evaluate to the original complex rational j function.
obligations.constructed_input: finite_evaluation and reciprocal_evaluation identify both coordinates; finite_J and reciprocal_J identify their quotients with ThreeCompactParameter318.J.
obligations.justification: The reciprocal formula explicitly requires T nonzero before denominator cancellation. Finite formula includes every T as a field expression; actual quotient inputs separately carry the required nonvanishing.

obligations.name: Original modular consumer and boundary values
obligations.required_input: The exact original quotient j map must be consumed at all original points, and both boundary source origins must have specified chart values.
obligations.constructed_input: original_j_finite and original_j_reciprocal consume quotientParameter_j; original_finite_denominator_ne_zero consumes quotientParameter_ne_zero. boundary_chart_values gives (3^18,0) at T=0 and (1,0) at S=0.
obligations.justification: The original quotient theorem includes elliptic points. No generic-locus identity is substituted. Both boundary coordinate pairs select the target reciprocal chart, but no pole order, morphism or arithmetic descent follows solely from these scalar values.

obligations.name: Verification and bounded next step
obligations.required_input: The changed application needs hosted kernel checking and distinct review before acceptance.
obligations.constructed_input: Four predecessor sources are byte-identical to the frozen atlas-r2 closure; two new modules and all imports are hashed in intake.json.
obligations.justification: This is an uncompiled inactive candidate. It supplies exact basepoint-free charts over Q and modular scalar comparison, not a global projective j scheme morphism. Next work must construct localization-based scheme maps, prove all overlaps and glue them; no first-batch packet is modified.
